instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js and .jsx files, NOT .tsx. The project uses Next.js 15 + React + Tailwind with .js files.
Implement a 5-step Cake Studio wizard (01 Occasion, 02 The Cake, 03 The Look, 04 Inspiration, 05 To Life).
Wizard State: Ensure a centralized state (e.g. React Context or a top-level component state) holds the 'YOUR SELECTION' / 'CURRENT VISION' summary data.
Use pill-shaped components for tags/flavors (rounded-full) and large rounded rectangles (rounded-3xl) for category selection cards. Include small circular icons (lucide-react) inside cards.
In the wizard, build an Inspiration/Moodboard section that supports multiple file uploads with a dashed upload box and Must-Have/Don't-Want tag inputs.
Cake Tracking Flow: Create a guest-accessible tracking page (using a tracking number input) with a distinct 3-step timeline: Request Quote -> Quoted -> Placed Order.
Admin Portal: Create an Admin section under 'Quotes' where admins can view quote requests, see all 5-step details, input a quote amount, and update the status.
Icons: Use lucide-react for the small circular icons inside cards and the stepper.
Font configuration: Implement 'Playfair Display' (serif) for the brand headings, and 'Outfit' (sans) for the UI text via next/font/google or standard stylesheet.
Ensure the final step (05 To Life) acts as a Review & Request Quote screen.
Navigation: Include a sticky/fixed bottom bar in the wizard for 'Back' and 'Next/Request Quote' actions.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header or bottom bar; use frosted glass backgrounds (backdrop-blur-md) with #fdf8f2 tint.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards, tracking timelines) for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
